$comment: The release manifest. This repository carries ONE release of the in-browser recompiler page of PeerInfinity/SWFRecomp-CC. `source.commit` is the commit whose build inputs (SWFRecomp/, SWFModernRuntime/) produced every BUILT file (`build.files`, sha256 each); `source.page.commit` is the commit the page files (docs/recompiler/) come from. `source.buildInputsUnchanged` is the measured `git diff --name-only` of the build inputs between the two, which may name only paths that are not build inputs. Written by SWFRecomp-CC tools/browser-release/make_release.py; nothing here is hand-edited except README.md, LICENSE, licenses/, catalog.json and examples/. `runtime` names what the page fetches at run time; those bytes are NOT in this repository.

allowlist.reason: licence text; CMake embeds only assets/NotoSans.ttf (--embed-file of that one file)

source.recipe: built files: git archive <source.commit> SWFRecomp SWFModernRuntime docs/recompiler | tar -x; bash SWFRecomp/scripts/deploy_wasm_demo.sh --build (emsdk 5.0.0); build_info.json `commit` set to the short SHA (the archive has no .git). Release: tools/browser-release/make_release.py at source.page.commit.

licence.note: LICENSE here = SWFRecomp-CC's root LICENSE at this commit, which changes only licence files after `commit`

sameAsPreviousRelease.basis: the previous release's committed blobs at 016d2b8d69d4988eaa699a0733d57b8dd50a40fd (md5-checked against its release.json)

runtime.requires: Chrome/Chromium 137+ (WebAssembly JSPI), WebGPU, SharedArrayBuffer (cross-origin isolation via recompiler/coi-serviceworker.js; in an iframe, via its Document-Isolation-Policy where the browser honours it)

fetches.verified: the page checks the sha256 before use; `?clangWebc=<url>` fetches it elsewhere (same check)
fetches.license: not declared in the registry (contents: LLVM/clang 16 + lld, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; a WASIX libc sysroot)
